Below is a quick‑reference list of the **five most‑high‑profile categories** that were highlighted during the **65th Annual Grammy Awards (held 13 March 2023)**, together with the winner in each category.

| # | Category (as presented at the ceremony) | Winner | Artist / Group | Additional notes (record‑producer / songwriter) |
|---|------------------------------------------|--------|----------------|-------------------------------------------------|
| 1 | **Record of the Year** | **“About Damn Time”** | **Lizzo** | Produced by Blake Slatkin & Ricky Reed; engineered by Mark “Spike” Stent & others. |
| 2 | **Album of the Year** | **“Harry’s House”** | **Harry Styles** | Produced by Kid Harpoon, Tyler Johnson, and Thomas Hull (Tom Auden). |
| 3 | **Song of the Year** | **“Just Like That”** | **Bonnie Raitt** *(songwriter)* | Written and performed by Bonnie Raitt. |
| 4 | **Best New Artist** | **Samara Joy** | *Samara Joy* (jazz vocalist) | Recognized for her breakout debut album **“Samara Joy”** (2022). |
| 5 | **Best Pop Solo Performance** | **“Easy on Me”** | **Adele** | Produced by Greg Kurstin; the song also won Song of the Year at the 2022 Grammys (but at the 65th ceremony it was honoured in the Pop‑Solo field). |

### Why these five?

- The **four “General Field”** awards (Record, Album, Song, and Best New Artist) are traditionally the headline categories of every Grammy ceremony.
- **Best Pop Solo Performance** is the next‑most‑watched category in the pop‑music segment and was highlighted prominently during the telecast, making it a natural “fifth” to pair with the General Field for a quick‑look summary.

> **Note:** The Grammys feature **over 80 distinct categories** spanning all genres and technical fields. If you were looking for a different set of five categories (e.g., a specific genre grouping), just let me know and I can pull the exact winners for those as well!
